objects.taxonomy_description: Small Old World monkey measuring 30-60 cm body length weighing 2-8 kg. Body covered with long hair around face forming distinctive facial ruff. objects.taxonomy_description: A manufactured object designed for play, distinguished from living organisms by its artificial material composition and static anatomical structure.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_Composition: The object exhibits synthetic textures such as molded plastic, plush fabric, or painted surfaces rather than biological skin, fur, or scales.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Anatomical_Articulation: Joints and limbs appear fixed, simplified, or mechanically articulated without the complex musculature or natural flexibility of a living creature.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Finish: Visible seams, mold lines, uniform paint application, or stitching indicate industrial manufacturing processes instead of natural growth patterns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Proportional_Symmetry: Body proportions often display exaggerated or stylized symmetry typical of design aesthetics, lacking the subtle asymmetries found in biological specimens.

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.
